# orca run

Every `orca run` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca run show <run> [--group <group>]`

one run: its entry in the group view, the newest 10 activity rows, the evidence summary

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id
- `--group <group>`: the run's group (default: found from the groups the summary lists)

## `orca run activity <run>`

a run's newest 200 activity rows, newest first

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id

## `orca run evidence <run> [--id <id>] [--max-bytes <max-bytes>]`

a run's evidence manifest, or one entry's content when --id names it

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id
- `--id <id>`: an evidence id the manifest lists: print that entry's content
- `--max-bytes <n>`: with --id: cap the content sent (default 262144; 0 sends the whole entry)

```
orca run evidence run-1
orca run evidence run-1 --id ev-1
```

## `orca run transcript <run> [--call <call>] [--before <before>] [--after <after>] [--thinking]`

a run's agent transcript: its calls, or one call's window (tail by default), redacted as the Web shows it

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id
- `--call <call>`: <attempt>/<phase>/<seq> as the call list prints it (default: list the calls)
- `--before <n>`: the window ending at this byte offset: pass a shown window's start to page back
- `--after <n>`: the window starting at this byte offset: pass a shown window's end to follow
- `--thinking`: include thinking events

```
orca run transcript run-1
orca run transcript run-1 --call 1/plan/1
orca run transcript run-1 --call 1/plan/1 --before 4096
```

## `orca run results <run>`

a run's saved results: the task's explanation and outputs per attempt, and whether the saved result can be recovered

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id

## `orca run eligibility <run>`

whether a run's saved result can be verified instead of re-run

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id
